content: Igyɛɛŋ ntɔn nzam a itɛk
Atɔŋ, mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làyöb ndaa yi: bànkaa abi banswà bàkäl ungyɛl a un'böŋ, ba banswà bàtsül ngyäl,
anà ba banswà bàwɛl ndüümà a Mɔsɛ uboo un'böŋ anà uboo a ngyäl.
Ba banswà bàdyee isaa a dweelà,
anà ba banswà bànwee kɔɔb a dweelà làmwɛy, ntɔn ba bànwee unsà un'kul a dweelà kàyikyeenà anà ba, un'kul awun kàkäl Klistɔ.
Wɛɛ, Nzam kàkäl anki un'sak anà bàmbɔɔn uboo a ba, lalan bàkü ba u nsye a ipɔl.
Ndaa ayi yanswà yà ntɔn naa ya ikäl mbaan, ntɔn bi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n aleŋ ube asànaa bàleŋà ba.
Twon lan'bulà baar a itɛk, asànaa bumwɛy uboo aba, kyakin bàsön naa: « Un'sɛŋ kan'bwaay ntɔn mudyà anà munwà, waa ba bàmbarà ntɔn mutaam. »
Bi sye ipà anki ndür abi mukyer ndaa a nswɛn, asànaa bàkyerà bumwɛy uboo a ba: kà ilä imwɛy mpɛl bàkü baar nsaab an'kwem mɔ̈ɔ̈l aŋitär.
Bi twon kun'sii Klistɔ, asànaa bàkyer bumwɛy uboo a ba: ntäy yàkyer adwa.
Twon lan'ŋüŋün asànaa bàŋüŋün bumwɛy uboo a ba: un'dwää kàkyer adwa.
Kyekà, indiir abi byàyeel ba ntɔn bya ikäl mbaan, bya bàsön ntɔn mulɔŋ bi, bi baar ibà u taaŋ a ntsüü.
Abun, wɛy mbuur akasii naa nde wà umbäär, ukäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà.

Ndɛb mwɛy tɛy ifàyeel bɛ ayà mpa ifàyeel mbuur. Nzam wà lää, nde upà anki mbwo naa bàlasii yàŋàlyaaŋ ngwal abɛ. Anà ndɛb, nde ayàlɔ̈ɔ̈n sye mbwo mutoo amu ya anà ayàlapà ngwal mukaŋ mpem.
Kyakin, nkween amɛ, làtiin muyamà itɛk.
Mɛ in'yäämà anà bɛ asànaa a baar abye anà an'kyän aŋàbwaŋ: làtsül bɛ ŋakwo ndaa in'tɛɛnà mɛ.
Kɔɔb a nsaak alà ifàsaak bi udu a la, nkye la làfisà anki unsà un'tüüb anà an'kil a Klistɔ? Làmpà ifàtsul bi, nkye la làfisà anki unsà un'tüüb anà ndür a Klistɔ?
Ntɔn làmpà là làmwɛy mpɛl, bi banswà ibà ndür mwɛy mpɛl: ntɔn bi banswà ifàkab làmpà mwɛy alan.
Wɛɛ làler baar a Isàlɛl, baar bàfàdyà in'twaŋ bàpɛ ibɔɔn, nkye ba un'tüüb watɛy anà mɛsà a ibɔɔn?
Ininà mɛ in'kwen mutɛn? Nkye in'twaŋ bàpɛ ibɔɔn akà itɛk lɛɛ itɛk bya ŋakwo ibye anà mfun?
Ŋaa! Wɛɛ, asànaa ibɔɔn aba bàkyàpà akà insɔŋà, kà akà Nzam anki, mɛ in'kwen anki naa bɛ làbilà unsà un'tüüb anà insɔŋà.
Bɛ làkwo anki munwà mbalà mwɛy ya u kɔɔb a Mwol anà u kɔɔb a insɔŋà. Bɛ làkwo anki mudyà mbalà mwɛy ya u mɛsà a Mwol anà u mɛsà a insɔŋà.
Nkye bi ikwen mumbaar un'köl a Mwol? Nkye bi ibye anà ngwal yan'lyaaŋ yà Nde?
Yanswà ntɔn làkoo a Nzam
« Byanswà bàkyàpà mbwo mukyer », wɛɛ kà bya byanswà anki ibye anà ndöŋ. « Byanswà bàkyàpà mbwo mukyer », wɛɛ kà bya byanswà anki byàfàtɔŋ.
Wɛy mbuur ukɔ̈ɔ̈n aleŋ ubwaŋ ande ŋakwo mpɛl, wɛɛ uleŋ sye ubwaŋ a baar bumwɛy.
Indiir byanswà bàfàyälà u yà, làdi bya làkɔɔn asà mfuul ntɔn mukɔɔn atay an'kyän,
ntɔn bàsön naa: « Mɛɛn anà indiir byanswà abyà uboo, byà Mwol. »
Isàkal naa mbuur mpa awe anà làkwikilà kàmàlabel anà bɛ lan'kyey mukyà, làdi indiir byanswà kàlapà nde, ukɔɔn asà mfuul ntɔn mukɔɔn atay an'kyän.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa mbuur an'tɛn abɛ naa: « Mi in'twaŋ myan'fà unsà ibɔɔn bàpɛ akà itɛk », twon lan'dyà wa, ntɔn mbuur kàlaweey anà ukɔɔn atay an'kyän.
Apà mɛ in'tɛɛnà anki ntɔn an'kyän abɛ, wɛɛ mànde. Ntɔn nkye an'kyän a mbuur asin itsüül ma nsaay amɛ nsaŋ?
Isàkal naa mɛ in'fàfuur an'tɔɔn ntɔn isaa in'fàdyà mɛ, ntɔn nkye in'bulà mɛ mbuur atwee ntɔn undiir an'fuur mɛ an'tɔɔn?
Abun, itàkal naa bɛ làkyer adyà, itàkal naa bɛ làkyer anwà, itàkal undiir wanswà làkyer bɛ, làkyer wanswà ntɔn làkoo a Nzam.
Twon lan'kal kyà ntɔn mbuur: itàkal ntɔn Ayudà, itàkal ntɔn Angɛlɛki, itàkal ntɔn Ikööŋ a Nzam.
Kyakin, mɛ ŋakwo in'fàkyer ngwal mupà un'sak akà baar banswà unsà indiir byanswà, kà ntɔn muleŋ ubwaŋ amɛ aŋàyen anki, wɛɛ ntɔn ubwaŋ a baar mbɔɔn, ntɔn ba bàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈.
